spans: This Agreement commences on the date it is executed and shall continue until full performance by both parties, or until earlier terminated by one party under the terms of this Agreement.

This Agreement will be for the maximum period of six (6) months beginning for the commencement date, renewable in accordance with the terms hereof, unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement.
This agreement shall be construed, interpreted and governed by and in accordance with the laws of Hong Kong.

All Intellectual Property during the project is owned by VAL, and will be turned over to VAL at the conclusion of the project by Developer and after the fulfillment of all commercial obligations by the VAL.
All rights and title to Duesey Coffee Intellectual Property created pursuant to the Project shall belong to VAL and shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement.

Parties.answer: VGrab Asia Ltd. ("VAL"); Mr. Zheng Qing, Mr. Gu Xianwin and Ms. Chen Weijie ("Developer")
